notes.title: Obscurant v1.1.0 - Patch Notes (Improved Controller Support!)
notes.content:
[h2]Added[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a virtual keyboard in the notebook for typing with a controller.
[*] Added Chapter Select feature to the main menu after completing the game.
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved idle animations for certain enemies and their corresponding disguises.
[*] Improved menu navigation when using a controller.
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where menu navigation could break when quitting to the main menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where confirmation modals would sometimes become stuck in certain menus.
[/list]

notes.title: Now Available on Mac and Linux!
notes.content:
[h3]Obscurant is now available on Mac and Linux![/h3]

That's right, you can now experience the mysteries of the Obscurance on macOS and SteamOS + Linux. Check out the Store Page for further information on supported operating systems and system requirements.

To go along with this, we've also enabled Steam Cloud support for Obscurant save files. This will allow you carry over your progress between your different machines.

Questions? Join the official Obscurant Discord to chat with developers and fellow players:
https://discord.com/invite/WJmZYqNB8y

notes.title: Obscurant v1.0.1 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Changed[/h2]

[list]
[*] Made it so that movement carries over between levels if the button is still held down.
[*] Updated Kingdom chase sequence to have a clearer and easier path.
[*] Improved visibility of Kurtovsk entrance.
[*] Updated the notebook to maintain the last opened page across levels.
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed soft lock that could occur when skipping the first disguise in Kurtovsk.
[*] Fixed bug where enemies were able to move through walls on rare occasions.
[*] Fixed bug where player could temporarily avoid scripted deaths.
[*] Fixed bug where combat disguise indicator would show the wrong disguise number.
[*] Fixed minor animation bugs with the player character.
[*] Fixed minor visual layering issues.
[*] Fixed various minor dialogue issues.
[/list]
